resolution_notes: rate_limits: Verifier B is correct. Official UniProt help (api, download, programmatic_access) documents fair-use and prefers streaming/bulk for large jobs; no fixed published hard per-IP ~5 req/s limit is currently stated. Original 5/s figure is not reconfirmed on live help pages—use fair-use/bulk guidance instead. Evidence: https://www.uniprot.org/help/api , https://www.uniprot.org/help/download , https://www.uniprot.org/help/programmatic_access
rate_limits: No fixed public hard per-IP rate (e.g. ~5 req/s) is currently documented on UniProt API help. Fair-use guidance applies; prefer streaming and bulk downloads for large jobs. Contact UniProt support for sustained high volume.
